note: Lions club campground in Noonan by the town water tower, at ND 5 and ND 40: an open gravel lot of back-in full-hookup sites inside a shelterbelt, with tenting. The club has no web page; the rate is camper-reported ($15 a night, September 2026), and that camper found grounding faults on three of the four electric pedestals checked and advises running the water clear first. --Claude
summary: No operator page (Lions club; ndtourism.com refuses, Divide County site 403). Dated camper report (Dyrt, 2026-09-15): $15/night, full hookups, no host, no reservations; fees and booking written as reported with a camper-reported line in the note. Imagery confirms the gravel lot at the pin.
flags: CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $15 a night, The Dyrt review dated 2026-09-15 (Ron S.); a year-old Google review also says '$15 FHU'. The operator (Noonan Lions Club) has no web page; ndtourism.com refuses plain HTTP and Divide County's site returns 403, both unread. The old note's ~$10 replaced.
